hard_gate: all current canonical constraints must pass; invalid variants are never ranked as eligible
model_limitations: components inherit structural simulator and opponent/pilot assumptions

normalization_policy.commander_independence: baseline dependency penalty minus variant dependency penalty, clamp [-1,1]
normalization_policy.physical_allocation: 1 only when current simultaneous physical allocation hard gate passes; otherwise variant is ineligible
normalization_policy.profile_deltas: variant minus baseline on bounded [0,1] profile scores
normalization_policy.robustness_components: minimum/equal-weight summaries of paired model-internal placement deltas normalized by pod range

weight_rationale: equal weights chosen ex ante to avoid tuning objective weights to observed optimizer outcomes; hard legality/inventory constraints remain lexically prior to score
